notes: Closed fixture for the T0302 jobs-cancel contract: pinned cancellation records computed by the reference cancel; malformed rows cover every failure class with a single-locus minimal repair (a corrupt done/dead job's repair is still not cancellable and fails job_not_cancellable); rollback rows prove a rejected cancel leaves the request type-exactly unchanged before a valid follow-up cancels as pinned. Payload shapes JSON cannot hold (non-finite floats, aliases, non-str keys) and hostile-type variants of every accepted request are derived in the battery, not stored here. Rows are stored one per line.
